import_people.description: Add people to your Luma calendar's audience by email so you can invite them to events and send them newsletters. You can optionally apply existing tags to keep them organized.
import_people.name: import_people

parameters.description: The email addresses of the people to add, separated by commas. For example: alex@example.com, sam@example.com
parameters.name: emails

parameters.description: Optional. The names of tags to apply to these people, separated by commas, for example: Newsletter, VIP. Each tag must already exist in your Luma calendar; new tags are not created automatically.
parameters.name: tag_names

emails.description: The email addresses that were imported.

tag_names.description: The tags applied to the imported people.

description: Add people to your Luma calendar so you can invite them to events and send them newsletters.
